column1: G0 is the LEGACY C REFERENCE: it is built from C, so byte-identity with
the PolyC generations is NOT expected and NOT required.  The permitted
G0-versus-PolyC comparison is SEMANTIC, and it is performed by
EXECUTING each generation's classifier over the whole token set (see
Each generation's object is the product of its OWN compiler, and the
build rules remove the target before each build:
The four producing compilers are DISTINCT binaries, and G2's and G3's
objects are not copies of G1's: they are the products of their own
compilers, which is what makes the byte-identity a FIXED-POINT result
